mapName: A RMRG Learnable Indonesia - Nusa Tenggara
authors: FredusBombastus, Atomo, MetaGeneratedBrain, Bcz_Idk, kree, OceanicPrairie, Avetixz, FreshBread (stefnej), Inferno, Juliette, MrPotota, ShadowGrif

metas.name: Alor Rock Wall
metas.note: Long rock walls are common on Alor. However unlike those on Rote, these walls are not made from limestone, so the stones are smoother, like large pebbles.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Bali Flat Farmlands
metas.note: Bali’s flat, expansive farmlands are primarily located in Jembrana and Tabanan regencies in the centre and southwest of the island.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Balinese Ornamental Plants
metas.note: Balinese residents have a strong tradition of cultivating ornamental plants around their homes and along public roads. Consequently, streets are frequently lined with flora such as Cordyline, Frangipani, Hibiscus, Bougainvillea, and the False Areca Palm.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Balinese Roof Ornaments
metas.note: Roof ornaments are a staple of Balinese architecture. Common features include crown-like decorations and wing-like finials at the roof ridge ends, often combined with a central element. These designs are also present in western Lombok and in neighbouring East Java, which have large Balinese populations
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Balinese Script
metas.note: Balinese employs a unique writing system derived from the Brahmi script family. Its characters are ornate and feature intricate, flowing curves, making them visually distinctive. However, with the widespread adoption of the national language, Indonesian, the traditional script is now rarely used in daily life
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Balinese Stone Wall
metas.note: In Bali, properties are typically enclosed by high stone walls, often adorned with basalt ornamentation.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Bamboo and Brick Architecture
metas.note: Houses on Alor often have a lower section made of brick and an upper section made of woven bamboo matting.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Bamboo House
metas.note: Houses made entirely of bamboo materials with sheet metal roofs are also frequently found on Sumba.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Blue Sticker
metas.note: In rare cases, blue pole stickers similar to those on Bali or Lombok are visible on Sumbawa.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Candi Bentar Gates
metas.note: These beautifully carved split gates, known as Candi Bentar, are a quintessential element of Balinese Hindu architecture. On Bali, they are predominantly crafted from dark, volcanic basalt. While they typically mark property entrances, they occasionally appear on public roads as well.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Corn on Sumba
metas.note: In western Sumba, corn is often cultivated on a large scale.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Dark Volcanic Boulders
metas.note: The eastern slopes of Mount Rinjani in Lombok can be identified by dark volcanic boulders and grey ash.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Denpasar Area
metas.note: Located in the south, Denpasar is the capital and largest city of the province. Significantly more urbanised than the rest of the island, it features bustling commercial districts and established residential neighbourhoods. Reflecting the thriving tourism industry, commercial signage is frequently multilingual.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Eastern Alor Red Soil
metas.note: Roads in the eastern part of Alor are surrounded by gentle hills of red soil.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Ende Bay
metas.note: The bay near Pulau Ende on Flores is one of the most recognisable bodies of water in Indonesia. It is sandwiched between tall mountains to the west and the majestic Gunung Meja and Iya to the east, with Pulau Ende sitting in the middle.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Flores Hat Roof
metas.note: Roofs shaped like hats are common in central Flores in areas that are ethnically Ngada, Nage and Ende. There is a very high concentration in the ethnically Ngada area around Bajawa where the houses also have distinct ornaments on both ends of the top beam.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Komodo Architecture
metas.note: Inhabitants of Komodo Island are descendants of Bugis from Sulawesi and of former convicts who were abandoned on the island. Buginese architecture therefore dominates, with triangular gables and gable horns. Green and blue are the most common colours, and houses are often built on stilts. Property boundaries are sometimes marked with loose rocks.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Komodo Blue Street Sign
metas.note: Blue street signs with an unusual font are common on Komodo Island.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Komodo Hills
metas.note: Komodo Island lies between the larger neighbouring islands of Sumbawa to the west and Flores to the east. Mountains surrounding Komodo Town are bare and covered with small trees.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Lewotolo Volcano
metas.note: Situated on the northern shore of Lembata, the Lewotolo volcano can be recognised by a heavy layer of white volcanic ash near its peak. The volcano is becoming increasingly active over the years and you can see volcanic ash erupting from its summit.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Limestone and Monsoon Landscape
metas.note: The peninsula south of Denpasar is characterised by arid monsoon forests. The terrain consists largely of white, powdery limestone. Roads are frequently cut directly into this rock, resulting in steep limestone embankments that flank the streets.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Lombok Agriculture
metas.note: Field boundaries in Lombok are wide and feature neatly cut grass, as well as small trees or other crops, distinguishing them from similar landscapes in Java.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Lombok Architecture
metas.note: Apart from ordinary Javanese tiles, roofs made of grey tiles are almost exclusive to Lombok. Another feature of Lombok architecture is the grey concrete block walls that surround properties.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Lombok Curved Roof
metas.note: This curved roof shape in Lombok is influenced by the traditional rice barns of the Sasak tribe. Whilst rice barns in their traditional form are rare, their influence can be seen in the shapes of houses, gates and shelters throughout Lombok.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Lush Eastern Bali
metas.note: The inland region of Karangasem Regency, located in eastern Bali, consists of steep volcanic hillsides cloaked in dense, lush rainforests and thick tropical vegetation, giving the area a dark green appearance.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Manggarai Conical House
metas.note: Western Flores is inhabited by the Manggarai people and their villages are usually centred around a traditional chieftain's house with a conical roof and a distinctive finial.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Matcha-Green Gras Hills
metas.note: Hills covered in matcha-green grass stretch from central Sumba towards the east coast. Trees are very rare and, when present, only cover parts of the hills. The further east you go, the more common this type of hilly landscape becomes.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Mesh Window Coverings
metas.note: Windows with bamboo mesh coverings are also a distinctive feature of houses on Alor.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Mountainous Central Bali
metas.note: Central Bali is a mountainous region, famous for its fruit cultivation. The rugged terrain is often shrouded in mist, creating a cool climate where coniferous and eucalyptus forests thrive. Several crater lakes add to the scenic beauty of this area.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: North of Denpasar Area
metas.note: Extending north from Denpasar, the land slopes gradually upwards to the volcanic peaks. This area is dominated by residential compounds and rice terraces.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Palmyra Palms on Bali
metas.note: Palmyra palms are predominantly found in the north-east part of the island.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Palmyra Palms on Sumba
metas.note: On the east coast of Sumba, you can find Palmyra palms.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Papaya along Property Boundaries
metas.note: Papaya trees along property boundaries are often visible on Timor.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Penida Terraced Rock Walls
metas.note: Limestone walls and terraced slopes are ubiquitous on Penida, whereas they are non-existent on Bali.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Penjor Bamboo Pole
metas.note: A Penjor is an elaborately decorated, long bamboo pole that serves as an important ritual object in Balinese Hinduism.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Pyrimidical Pavilion on Stils
metas.note: These pavilions on stilts with a pyramidal roof can be found throughout Lombok and Sumbawa.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Red Brick
metas.note: Red brick houses are widespread on the Nusa islands of Sumbawa and Alor. They also occur on Lombok, Flores, Lembata and Adonara, but less frequently.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Remote Western Bali
metas.note: Jembrana Regency in the west is more remote, with a lower population density. Roads are lined by dense, wild greenery rather than continuous construction and the area feels much more spacious and less enclosed. A defining feature of this region is the mown grass verges flanking the roads.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Rice Terraces
metas.note: In western Flores you can also find rice terraces in a mountainous setting. Rice terraces in such a setting are not found on other islands in the Nusas.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Rote Landscape
metas.note: Palmyra palms, banana plants and Bellyache bush are a familiar sight on Rote. Bellyache bush can be recognised by its green and purple leaves.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Rote Palm Stalk Fence
metas.note: Fences made from palm stalks in a tight wicker-weave pattern are common on Rote.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Rote Rock Wall
metas.note: On Rote, plots of land and fields are surrounded by distinctive long walls made from piled-up stones.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Ruteng Valley
metas.note: The Ruteng valley in western Flores is marked by a series of volcanoes forming a wall to its south.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Savannah Landscape
metas.note: The north-east coast of Sumba is the most arid part of the whole country, with a highly distinctive savannah landscape with few trees.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Sembalun Caldera Village
metas.note: The high altitude village of Sembalun sits in a valley between the rugged green mountains of the Rinjani caldera. The landscape is easily recognisable due to the barren and treeless slopes.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Sheet Metal Fence
metas.note: On Sumbawa, you will find an unusually high number of sheet metal fences compared to the rest of Indonesia. Fences and gates made of bamboo are also common.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Square Pavement
metas.note: Roads or walkways paved with dark, square paving stones are ubiquitous on Bali. These blocks are typically laid in either a straight grid or a diagonal diamond pattern.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Sumba Christian Graves
metas.note: Graves on the predominantly Christian Sumba are often in the shape of a rectangular frustum with a flat table-like top.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Sumba Limestone Formations
metas.note: Sumba has exposed limestone formations, particularly in the northern coastal areas. These were formed from ancient coral reefs. Deeper inland, they may contrast with reddish soil.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Sumba Thatched Roof
metas.note: On the western tip of Sumba you can find these types of traditional houses with thatched roofs. The white brick houses typical of the Nusas are also found all over Sumba.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Sumbawa Landscape
metas.note: Most roads on Sumbawa are on very flat terrain. However the island has lots of mountains that are always visible from these plains. Flores in contrast is entirely hilly.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Sumbawa Roofs
metas.note: Sumbawa marks the boundary of the transition from tiled roofs to sheet metal roofs. While a mix of both can be found on the island’s west side, the east side is dominated by sheet metal roofing.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Sumbawa Tree Fence
metas.note: In rural Sumbawa, fields are separated from the road by rows of trees which are often pollarded. These are similar to the rows of trees that can be seen in Colombia.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Tedung Umbrella
metas.note: Tedung are tall, slender ceremonial umbrellas decorated with hanging tassels or fringes. They usually appear in bright yellow, white, red or a black-and-white checkered pattern. They are typically found standing next to shrines or temple gates; however, they can also be found in other settings.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Tiled Buginese House
metas.note: A good indicator for Sumbawa is tiled Buginese houses. These are recognisable by their tiled horizontal roof flap across the gable. The tiles are often the same style that is found on Java. This style of tile is not found on Sulawesi. These houses also typically lack balconies and are surrounded by fences.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Timber Frame House
metas.note: The most distinctive house types on Timor feature a boxy timber frame central section infilled with palm or bamboo. This type of house may also rarely be found on Rote.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Timor Speckled Ditch
metas.note: Within the Nusas there is a special type of roadside drainage ditch, that occurs commonly on Timor and to a lesser extent on Flores and Alor. This special ditch type is characterized by its dark mortar, flecked with white stones.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Timor Thatched Roof
metas.note: Traditional bamboo houses with thatched roofs are found scattered across Timor. These houses sometimes have a circular shape. Modern versions with metal roofs can also be found. Unlike Manggarai chieftain houses, these often have a short ridge with two small horns along the top.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Timor Tree Fence
metas.note: Fences made out of trees, some pollarded, and fences made from horizontally-stacked sticks are found along road sides on Timor and Rote.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Traditional Alor High House
metas.note: Traditional houses on Alor have a characteristic arrow-tip shape, are raised on stilts and feature thatched or sheet metal roofs.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Volcanoes on Bali
metas.note: Bali is home to several volcanoes, with the two most prominent being Mount Agung in the north-east and Mount Batukaru in the centre. Mount Agung is the island’s highest peak, easily identifiable by its massive, symmetrical cone that towers over the surrounding landscape. Mount Batukaru, by contrast, consists of a complex of multiple peaks.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Western Alor Coast
metas.note: Three islands are clearly visible off the west coast of Alor. The largest of these, Pura Island, is easily recognisable.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Western Flores Landscape
metas.note: The western tip of Flores has a unique dry landscape of undulating hills. In addition, the main road passing through here is distinctive for its concrete paving and green plastic netting on the cliffy roadsides.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Western Sumba Landscape
metas.note: The west side of Sumba meanwhile is quite humid with fields surrounded by hills and poor road quality.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: White Brick
metas.note: White brick houses are widespread on the Nusa islands of Timor, Rote and Sumba while red brick houses are much less common.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group

metas.name: Wide Gapped Bamboo Fence
metas.note: Bamboo fences on Alor, Lembata and Adonara have noticeably large open spaces between both horizontal and vertical bamboo bars.
metas.footer: Based on https://rmrg.me/guides/nusa-islands/. Feel free to join our Discord: Real Meta Research Group
